cards.program: Mays MS Quantitative Finance (MS-QFIN / STEM to Stocks)
cards.schedule_note: 36-hour non-thesis MS jointly offered by Adam C. Sinn '00 Department of Finance with Department of Mathematics. Catalog does not lock Fall-only vs multi-term calendar on the degree page; application dates deferred to Finance department site. Distinct from classic 4+1 MS Finance (tamu-msf).
cards.full_time_placement_notes: No MS-QFIN-specific CSEA/employment PDF or published internship/FT % located 2026-10-26. Do NOT substitute classic Mays 4+1 MS Finance (tamu-msf) figures: MSF program page/FT news claim 100% job success among active seekers at graduation and first-year salary bands (~$80k–$100k; some $180k+ total first-year; FT Masters in Finance 2026 alumni avg salary $121,625) — those are MSF outcomes, related college/program family only. STEM to Stocks director bio (Misty Page) states a ~40-company corporate advisory board employs approximately half of MSF/MSQF students annually — combined MSF+MSQF narrative, not an audited MS-QFIN-only rate.
cards.notable_employers_notes: No MS-QFIN-only graduate hire list with counts found. Adjacent MSF Advisory Board page (shared STEM to Stocks career ecosystem; titled MSF) lists 35+ firms including Goldman Sachs, Citi, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Macquarie, RBC Capital Markets, Houlihan Lokey, McKinsey, Big 4, ExxonMobil, ConocoPhillips, Texas Instruments, UTIMCO — board page states ~50% of MSF program students accepted intern/FT at a board company in AY2024. Treat as network signal for the Finance department master's complex, not as verified MS-QFIN placement employers.
cards.top_finance_firm_signal: Unknown for MS-QFIN alone. Curriculum targets quantitative/technical roles (security research, data/analytics, fintech, model development, portfolio management, quant trading, risk, software). Adjacent STEM to Stocks / MSF advisory board includes bulge/elite and Texas energy/corp finance recruiters, but those hire stats are not disaggregated to MS-QFIN.
sample_alumni_paths: unknown (no MS-QFIN-specific alumni path distribution published)

Catalog target roles (curriculum intent, not outcomes): complex security research; data and analytics; fintech; model development; portfolio management; quantitative trading; risk management; software development
cards.referral_network_notes: Catalog: access to Mays Graduate Career Management Center, individual career coaching, soft-skill development (STEM to Stocks). Shared director/career course (FINC 601) with MSF; student directory for MSF and MSQF employers. MSF Advisory Board (~35+ firms) + January roadshows to Austin/Dallas/Houston advisory employers historically cover MSF/MSQF cohorts. Strength of external/non-TAMU MS-QFIN referrals unproven vs TAMU 4+1 pipeline.
cards.difficulty_notes: Catalog: highly selective; advanced math (calc sequence required B+; linear algebra, DE, stats, coding recommended). Dual audience: TAMU undergrads (soph/jr/sr) and non-TAMU graduates with equivalent prereqs. No dedicated public MS-QFIN employment report; QuantNet forum anecdotes (secondary, unverified) are mixed — not used as stats. Official STEM CIP for OPT extension not confirmed on catalog page (STEM to Stocks is branding / audience, not proof of CIP).
cards.intl_student_notes: EXTERNAL OPEN — CONFIRMED: official Graduate Catalog states admission available to current Texas A&M sophomore/junior/senior students OR non-Texas A&M graduates meeting prereq equivalents (ACCT, ECON, MATH calc sequences) with B or higher by end of TAMU spring immediately following admission. Not combo-only (unlike restricted tamu-msf). INTL OPEN — CONFIRMED (no citizenship bar on catalog; Mathematics graduate master's application materials explicitly document international applicants — native+English transcripts, TOEFL iBT 80 / TOEFL Essentials 8.5 / IELTS 6.0 unless waiver, $114 intl app fee, earlier intl deadlines May 15 Fall / Sept 15 Spring). Arts & Sciences Mathematics lists Quantitative Finance M.S. as Finance+Math collaboration. Caveat: Mays live marketing is dominated by 4+1 MSF pages; a dedicated MS-QFIN Fall 2027 intl deadline landing was not located this pass — brief should lock app portal/deadlines. Official STEM CIP / STEM-OPT eligibility for MS-QFIN: unknown (confirm with ISSS/I-20 CIP).
